h1: The Scourging at the Pillar: Second Sorrowful Mystery
intro: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Scourging at the Pillar.
shortAnswer: This book walks children through the Second Sorrowful Mystery, the Scourging at the Pillar: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on purity and healing from sin.
aboutHtml:
Painting: William-Adolphe Bouguereau, Flagellation. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Image source (Wikimedia Commons).

The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Tuesday / Friday.

faq.q: What is the Second Sorrowful Mystery?
faq.a: The Scourging at the Pillar. Jesus was bound to a pillar and scourged, though he had done nothing wrong. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Tuesday / Friday, and its fruit is purity and healing from sin.

faq.q: How do you pray this decade with children?
faq.a: Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.
